_note: Screens the ledger calls implemented that the gate cannot judge today,
each with an issue. A quarantined screen's failures are printed and
recorded, never blocking — and one that starts passing every facet FAILS
the run, so a stale quarantine cannot survive the thing it was hiding
The three G-2 entries share one root: the onboarding terms/status screens
read the in-session application from sessionStorage (written by the g2_1
register form), and the gate's arrival vocabulary can only cold-load a
route — it lands on the honest 'No application in progress' frame. The
screens are proven by apps.spec.js, which drives the whole flow; the gap
is the gate's, and #179 is where it closes.

g2_4.why: Implemented at console #/onboard/status, but the screen shows the application the session started and the gate arrives with no session — it sees 'No application in progress', not the decided registration g2_4 draws (state, exact terms version, decider). Needs a scripted-flow arrival mode in the gate.

g2_11.why: Implemented at console #/onboard/terms, but the published-terms screen is scoped to the session's in-progress application (orgId from sessionStorage) and the gate arrives with no session — it sees 'No application in progress' instead of the terms list and 'Request these terms'. Needs a scripted-flow arrival mode in the gate.

g2_13.why: Implemented at console #/onboard/status (the approved terminal state of the same status screen as g2_4), and unreachable by cold-loading the route for the same reason — no in-session application, so the gate sees 'No application in progress'. Needs a scripted-flow arrival mode in the gate.
